h1_diagnostic_rule: H1/H2 may retain explicit diagnostic boundaries and projections needed for causal tests; these are not commitments to final H3 physical service boundaries.

logical_planes.rule: canonical semantic identity, epochs, provenance, conflict and replay state
bounded rebuildable cognitive projection; cannot become truth or authority
ClayGraph-like topology is derived/transient in final target unless evidence requires otherwise
selection/broadcast/re-entry observability and intervention plane, not truth
4B transforms state and proposes actions; no direct effects
fresh dependency/capability revalidation before durable/effect promotion
opaque/sealed capabilities, revocation, cumulative budgets, receipts, recovery
proposal-only local recurrence controller with regime plus readout-quality identity
independent peers provide provenance-rich deltas, never authority or full-state identity collapse
Digital Retina/MVC evidence is typed perceptual state; familiarity is not sensor truth

active_assembly_contract: shared ancestry cannot count as independent replication
shared ancestry cannot erase unresolved contradictory propositions
conflict observability independent of ancestry diversity accounting
stable re-expansion references for omitted detail
loop_controller_contract: distinguish CONVERGING_FIXED_POINT PRODUCTIVE_LIMIT_CYCLE STALLED DIVERGING_OR_OVERTHINKING CHAOTIC_OR_UNCLASSIFIED
low_state_delta plus high_residual_pressure means STALLED not CONVERGED
invalid stale missing or over-uncertain readout routes fail-closed rather than declaring convergence
expected marginal verified gain must exceed recurrence plus instability cost under remaining budget
GWT focus may inform but cannot solely determine recurrence
snapshot_commit_contract: cognition read snapshot is materialized/closed before effect commit
fresh commit transaction revalidates effect-relevant dependency closure
unrelated state change alone does not force abort
newly required undeclared dependency forces reassembly
durable promotion and effect authority remain separate stages
negative_or_unsettled: prepared ActiveAssembly has not yet beaten MMR/diversity-aware retrieval on real frozen H1 traces
ancestry caps can hide same-family contradictions unless conflict observability is separate
adaptive recurrence has only synthetic/reference support; fixed/event-driven control may win at matched wall-clock cost
observer instrumentation may alter timing-sensitive causal trajectories
dependency-closure safety fails if dependencies are incomplete or dynamically laundered
model-internal recurrent depth is a separate later hypothesis and is not required for FRANK-level recurrence
diagnostic ClayGraph/temporary modules must not fossilize into H3 physical architecture without evidence
next_discriminators: H1 top-k/MMR versus prepared ActiveAssembly at fixed 4B context with conflict/provenance/re-expansion metrics
H1 fixed/event-driven versus delta-only versus trajectory-quality post-hoc versus focus-only recurrence at matched cost
truthful versus shuffled versus absent re-entry
local self-verifier versus independent strong-peer verification including peer loss/stale/shuffle
